mapper.select: SELECT kp.id, kp.code, kp.name, kp.description, COUNT(DISTINCT q.id) AS question_count FROM knowledge_point kp LEFT JOIN question_knowledge_point qkp ON qkp.knowledge_point_id = kp.id LEFT JOIN question q ON q.id = qkp.question_id AND q.type = 'PUBLIC' AND q.deleted = 0 GROUP BY kp.id, kp.code, kp.name, kp.description, kp.sort ORDER BY kp.sort ASC, kp.id ASC
